name: wook8170-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Wook Jang: a process harness, an agent workbench, and a production-readiness audit.

plugins.name: king-wjang-harness
plugins.description: Hook and CLI harness that enforces design → build → ship process discipline. Completely silent in projects without a .harness/ directory.

plugins.name: wb
plugins.description: Workbench for running parallel Claude Code agent lanes: model routing, lane and slot limits, git safety guards, handoff and review.

plugins.name: verifying-production-readiness
plugins.description: Use when judging whether a system can ship to production — pre-launch sign-off, go/no-go calls, release readiness audits, "can we ship this?", "확인만 하고 올리자", or when resuming and iterating on a prior readiness report.
